description: This file contains a jQuery plugin for drag-and-drop functionality on HTML tables, including initialization, event handling, and hierarchy support.

methods.name: parseStyle
methods.description: Parses a CSS string into an object map.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes drag-and-drop on tables with options.

methods.name: makeIndented
methods.description: Prepares table rows for hierarchy indentation.

methods.name: makeDraggable
methods.description: Makes table rows draggable, optionally using a handle.

methods.name: currentOrder
methods.description: Returns the current order of rows based on their IDs and levels.

methods.name: initialiseDrag
methods.description: Begins dragging a table row, capturing mouse events.

methods.name: updateTables
methods.description: Reinitializes draggable tables.

methods.name: mouseCoords
methods.description: Gets mouse coordinates from an event.

methods.name: getMouseOffset
methods.description: Calculates mouse offset relative to a target element.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of an element in the document.

methods.name: autoScroll
methods.description: Auto scrolls window during drag if near edges.

methods.name: moveVerticle
methods.description: Moves a row vertically based on drag direction.

methods.name: moveHorizontal
methods.description: Moves a row horizontally for hierarchy levels.

methods.name: mousemove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events during dragging.

methods.name: findDragDirection
methods.description: Determines drag direction based on mouse movement.

methods.name: findDropTargetRow
methods.description: Finds the row over which the dragged row is hovering.

methods.name: processMouseup
methods.description: Handles drop logic when mouse is released.

methods.name: mouseup
methods.description: Handles mouse up event to finalize drag.

methods.name: jsonize
methods.description: Serializes table data to JSON.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes table data to URL-encoded string.

methods.name: serializeTable
methods.description: Serializes a single table's row IDs.

methods.name: serializeTables
methods.description: Serializes all tables on the page.

methods.name: tableData
methods.description: Returns structured data of table rows for serialization.
